stops.note: a respectful word for an elder, probably from nursery speech; the Rule of St Benedict tells younger monks to call their seniors nonnus, 'reverend father'
Anglo-Saxon double monasteries of monks and nuns, like Whitby under Abbess Hild (d. 680), were ruled by women
reinforced by Old French nonne; Henry VIII's Dissolution of the Monasteries in 1536-41 closed every English convent

current_meaning: a woman living in a religious community under vows
